description:
Apply a 'Unique Values' symbology classification to the countries layer based on the continent field.

Starting state: gvSIG is open with a new, empty project.

Your goal:
1. Open a new View and add the shapefile: `/home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp`
2. Open the layer's Properties (double-click the layer or right-click > Properties).
3. Go to the 'Symbology' tab.
4. Change the classification method to 'Categories' -> 'Unique values'.
5. Select `CONTINENT` as the Classification field.
6. Click 'Add all' (or 'Insert all') to generate categories for all continents (Africa, Asia, Europe, etc.).
7. Ensure that each continent has a different color assigned.
8. Click OK to apply.
9. Save the project as `/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/continent_categories.gvsproj`.
10. Export the map view as an image to `/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/continent_map.png` (using View > Export to Image or similar).

Success is determined by the project file configuration and the visual appearance of the exported map.
